title: 1428 Brickell
description: Luxury residences in Brickell Miami featuring private elevators, panoramic views and world-class amenities.
features:
Overview

Viceroy Brickell Residences represents a new generation of branded luxury living in Miami. Developed by Related Group and GTIS Partners, the tower combines contemporary architecture by Arquitectonica with interiors by Meyer Davis and the legendary hospitality of Viceroy Hotels & Resorts.

Positioned where the Miami River meets Brickell, the residences offer panoramic city and waterfront views while providing immediate access to Brickell City Centre, Downtown Miami, Coconut Grove, Key Biscayne, and Miami International Airport.

Residents enjoy an elevated lifestyle focused on wellness, design, personalized services, and world-class amenities, making Viceroy one of the most desirable residential addresses in Brickell.

title: Cipriani Residences Miami
description: Luxury waterfront residences in Brickell Miami.
features:
Cipriani Residences Miami brings the legendary Italian hospitality brand to the center of Brickell.

Designed by Arquitectonica with interiors by 1508 London, the tower rises above Miami’s financial district offering expansive residences with sweeping views of Biscayne Bay, Simpson Park, and the Brickell skyline.

Inspired by nearly a century of Cipriani heritage, every residence reflects timeless design, elevated service, and effortless luxury.

Residents enjoy signature Cipriani hospitality, private dining experiences, wellness amenities, resort-style pools, and personalized concierge services.

Highlights:

Architecture by Arquitectonica
Interiors by 1508 London
Signature Cipriani services
Resort-style amenities
Panoramic Bay and Skyline views
Private dining experiences
Prime Brickell location

title: St. Regis Residences Miami
description: Ultra-luxury waterfront residences in Brickell featuring expansive floorplans, private elevators, St. Regis services, and panoramic Biscayne Bay views.
features:
St. Regis Residences Miami

Located directly on Biscayne Bay in the heart of Brickell, St. Regis Residences Miami redefines luxury waterfront living through timeless design, expansive residences, and legendary St. Regis hospitality.

Created as a design-driven residential collection, the project combines refined architecture, private residential amenities, curated services, and panoramic water views to deliver one of Miami's most prestigious residential addresses.

Each residence has been conceived as a seamless extension of indoor and outdoor living, featuring oversized terraces, floor-to-ceiling glass, and private elevator access.

title: JEM Private Residences
description: Discover JEM Private Residences at Miami Worldcenter, offering luxury residences, premium amenities, contemporary design, and an exceptional Downtown Miami lifestyle.
features:
Overview

JEM Private Residences is a luxury residential tower located within Miami Worldcenter, one of the largest mixed-use developments in the United States.

Designed to blend modern architecture with elevated hospitality-inspired living, JEM offers residents an exceptional collection of amenities, thoughtfully designed residences, and immediate access to world-class dining, shopping, entertainment, and cultural destinations.

Its strategic location places residents just minutes from Brickell, Biscayne Bay, Wynwood, the Design District, Miami International Airport, and Miami Beach, creating an ideal balance between business, leisure, and luxury living.
